Sporefused Verdant Seed has a chance to drop from Sporefused herbs throughout Khaz Algar. The player must have at least 30 Khaz Algar Herbalism Knowledge in the Cultivation (Herbalism) sub-specialization of the Botany specialization in order to receive the item. It can be planted at Beledar's Bounty of Hallowfall to grow into a random Sporefused Khaz Algar herb.

Sporefused herbs are variants of herbs found rarely throughout Khaz Algar. They can be gathered by players with the Herbalism skill and give both the herb and Viridescent Spores. Gathering sporefused herbs afflicts the player with Sporefused Visions, a debuff that lasts 15 seconds and causes orbs of spore to appear around the player every few seconds. These spores detonate after a few seconds to deal light damage to the afflicted player if they are nearby. Overloading the herb will cause four additional herbs to spawn. Picking the herb that does not match the other three gives the herb and causes a new set of herbs to spawn. Irradiated herbs have a green glow to them.
Sporefused Luredrops are found in Khaz Algar. Players with Herbalism can gather these Herbs.

, a sporeglider in Harandar.]] Sporegliders are a type of large sporebat-like creature with six wings found in Harandar and Naigtal.
